☁️ AWS Serverless Architecture

AWS Serverless Array Sorting API

Cloud-native microservice built on the AWS serverless stack to process dynamic JSON payloads, execute sorting algorithms, and monitor real-time invocation metrics.

⚙️ Key Engineering Solution:

Configured REST API endpoints via Amazon API Gateway with CORS enabled, handled by AWS Lambda running Python logic, with full logging in AWS CloudWatch.

AWS LambdaAPI GatewayPythonJavaScriptCloudWatch

📈 Machine Learning & Cloud

Flight Fare Forecasting Platform

AI-driven aviation fare prediction dashboard surfacing historical price trends, route comparisons, and travel insights.

⚙️ Key Engineering Solution:

Integrated Facebook Prophet time-series prediction models with live flight data from the Amadeus API, backed by structured PostgreSQL storage via Supabase.

PythonProphet MLSupabaseAmadeus API

A synchronized dual-interface system serving end-users via a web interface and administrators via a desktop application.
